verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official CLI documented on its own docs site, and the docs say it can create builds that enrich releases in the dashboard. Beyond that single command, the evidence is thin. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's broader command set (e.g. source map/symbol uploads, querying errors), AI/agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
